newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche-no comment on reports of control changes.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche-no comment on reports of control changes.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Bank AG on Friday said it had no comment to make on a press report that it was considering shifting control of MGAM's unit trust business to Frankfurt from London.

The Financial Times newspaper had cited Deutsche Bank board member Rolf Breuer as saying the management board had already discussed such a switch and would continue to do so in the light of the crisis at Morgan Grenfell Asset Management (MGAM), its London asset management unit.
A spokesman for Deutsche said he could not comment on the report. Similar stories were carried in the German press.
Breuer has overall responsibility for Deutsche's asset management worldwide, but MGAM reports to Michael Dobson, the London-based head of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Deutsche's investment banking arm.

MGAM this week suspended two fund managers pending an investigation by regulators into alleged irregularities in the management of three of its funds. The incident has sparked an internal review of Deutsche's control mechanisms.
